entries.speaker: Persistent Male Fan
entries.en: Thank you for shaking my hand![n]I'm never gonna wash it!

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...Huh? Um, please wash it.

entries.speaker: Persistent Male Fan
entries.en: I can't believe that you're really here...[n]in a church...

entries.speaker: Persistent Male Fan
entries.en: I read on the internet that you pray[n]to God for victory. Is that true?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: No...

entries.speaker: Persistent Male Fan
entries.en: Can I take a selfie with you and[n]post it online?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Sorry, I've been turning down all[n]such requests...

entries.speaker: Persistent Male Fan
entries.en: By the way, is it true that you're trying to[n]become a professional shogi player?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Well, nothing's been...

entries.speaker: Persistent Male Fan
entries.en: I'll be cheering for you to qualify![n]You'd be the first woman to surpass[n]the third-dan league!

entries.speaker: Persistent Male Fan
entries.en: I really believe in you!

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...Thank you very much.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Oh... good evening.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Men like that approach me all the time.[n]At first, I thought you were one of them...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...I really must apologize for being rude[n]to you...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: It bothers me when people make[n]such a big fuss over me...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Considering that the priest is doing me[n]a great favor by letting me play here...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: You see, he's my shogi friend.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: And he's very kind. He once told me[n]that he wanted to become a professional[n]player.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...And he doesn't laugh at my[n]embarrassing habit when we[n]play together.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: So... I did the photoshoot.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I'm embarrassed just thinking about it...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Did you see it...? It was called[n]"The Venus of Shogi"...
Describes you perfectly.[clr 27]
No, I didn't.
That's quite the headline.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: N-Nonsense...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Please stop...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Huh...?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Th-Then... Oh no, it would seem I have[n]just dug my own grave...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: It certainly is...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Um, it's not really an excuse, but[n]the editorial staff came up with[n]that title on their own...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Ever since I won the female shogi league,[n]I've been getting a lot of attention.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I just figured I could contribute to[n]the shogi world... Besides, my[n]mother seems to be very happy...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Whenever I win, she rejoices as if[n]it were her own victory...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: So I want to live up to the expectations[n]she has for me...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...However, she's been a bit overzealous[n]lately. She set up the interview and[n]photoshoot.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: It's as if she wants to be the manager of[n]a celebrity.
You don't enjoy it?
Having a difficult time?[clr 27]
You should just decline.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...No, to be honest.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...But it's all right.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...A bit.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...But it's fine, because it's for my mother.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...I can't...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Oh, sorry! I should be teaching you[n]how to play instead of talking about[n]my mother.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Today, I'll be showing you something[n]very practical...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: It's a tactic for using the reserved pawns[n]you've taken from your opponent in a[n]more effective way.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Nevertheless... I apologize. You're such[n]a good listener, I feel at ease speaking[n]with you...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Aside from the priest, you're actually[n]the first person I've spoken to about[n]my mother...
I feel Hifumi's trust in me growing...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Now then, I will instruct you[n]while we play.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Are you ready...?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Well then, I look forward to our[n]next match.
